# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - NOT REAL EXPERIMENTAL DATA, NOT FROM ANY BEAMLINE.
#
# Hand-written for apps/api/tests/test_historical_import.py so the Historical
# Import shell has something to parse. Every value below is fictional: the
# material, the detector and the operator do not exist, and this file was never
# produced by an instrument.
#
# THE FORMAT IS THIS FIXTURE'S OWN and is not a beamline convention. It is
# `key = value`, one per line, where the key is written as an OFFICIAL ISAAC
# FIELD PATH. That is deliberate: the shell's reconstruction provider maps a key
# to a field path only when the key IS that path verbatim, so this file encodes
# no beamline vocabulary and no alias table. BL15-002 (the real Beamline
# Profile) stays blocked, and nothing here may be read as evidence about it.
#
# Between them, bundle A and bundle B exercise the four outcomes the import
# review surface has to be able to show:
#   agreed and writable    -> system.technique
#   sources disagree       -> sample.material.name
#   recognised, unwritable -> system.configuration.detector_model
#   not a field path       -> operator_initials

system.technique = XAS
sample.material.name = SYNTHETIC-CuO-FAKE-001
system.configuration.detector_model = SYNTHETIC-DETECTOR-MODEL-ZERO
operator_initials = ZZ

this line carries no separator and is reported as skipped
